title: Signature Verification — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Signature Verification solution should meet the objective: Verify a signed message using a domain-bound scheme, authorize the intended signer, and reject reused message identifiers. Use local deterministic test keys only. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
